_about: Heavy fighter (design doc, Initial unit roster: air). EVERY VALUE IS A PLACEHOLDER proposed by Track S on 2026-10-09 so the demo can fly; the unit design sheet and its variant boards replace them. Plausible for a WWII twin-engine fighter (P-38, Bf 110, Beaufighter class) at true scale: about as fast as the light fighter, heavier and less agile. Record shape: data/units/_schema.json.
name: Heavy fighter

size_m._reason: twin-engine fighter span: P-38 15.8 m, Bf 110 16.3 m

actions_per_turn._reason: Alex 2026-10-09 accepted this as the demo baseline. Was proposed: fast but less agile than the light fighter: one decision point fewer; 4 steps of 1.25 s in a 5 s turn

health._reason: between the light fighter and the bomber

sight_range_m._reason: Alex 2026-10-09 accepted the lead's fog recommendation (about 800 m so sight edges show at play zoom). Was proposed: same as the light fighter; unused until Track F's vision rule

speed_min_mps._reason: stall about 180 km/h, heavier wing loading than the light fighter

speed_cruise_mps._reason: about 380 km/h; long-range twins cruised a little faster

speed_max_mps._reason: about 595 km/h, P-38 class at low altitude

dive_speed_max_mps._reason: heavy aircraft gain speed fast in a dive

accel_mps2._reason: two engines but more mass: cruise to top in about 17 s (3-4 turns)

decel_mps2._reason: more momentum to shed than the light fighter

turn_rate_curve_dps._reason: three quarters of the light fighter's rate at each point: a 24 s circle at cruise

turn_bleed_mps2._reason: above its 3.5 m/s^2 of thrust, so a sustained hard turn costs speed

turn_bleed_exponent._reason: induced drag grows with the square of the load factor

bands_per_step._reason: one band per step keeps a climb a deliberate, visible choice

climb_speed_cost_mps._reason: more mass to lift than the light fighter

dive_speed_gain_mps._reason: heavier aircraft gain a little more in a dive; still less than the climb costs

hardpoints._reason: the lead's engagement-cones proposal (variants/engagement-cones/weapons_proposed.json), shown to Alex 2026-10-09, not yet decided. On the nose, 8 m forward of the centre

base_hit_chance._reason: Track C proposal (not in the lead's sheet): a cannon fires less often and hits harder: 2 pips at 0.3 once a second is 0.6 pips a second on a centred target, about the pair of machine guns, at a longer range and in a narrower cone

rim_odds_factor._reason: Track C proposal: a fixed gun is peaked (the lead's sheet: 'better near the centre'; Alex: a machine gun has better odds the closer the target is to the centre of its cone): a target on the rim has a fifth of the centre's odds

falloff_exponent._reason: Track C proposal: a quadratic fall (r squared) keeps the odds high through the inner half and drops them near the rim
